content:
Hi all,

I've started to port boxes.v, and it has a lot of laterIf propositions. It seems we don't have a lot of support for them in the proof mode. It would make sense to redefine laterIf as laterN (match b with | false => 0 | _ => 1) P. It is defined like that in the Rocq version as well.
It is seldom used in the project for now, but just in case someone planned to use it, I'll do the change next week.
Yes, I guess that change makes sense.
